mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(s.total), 0) from pos_sale s where
select count(1) from pos_product p where coalesce(p.stock, 0) > 0

select date_format(s.sale_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateLabel, coalesce(sum(s.total), 0) as sales, count(1) as orders from pos_sale s where and s.sale_time >= #{startTime} and s.sale_time < #{endTime} group by date_format(s.sale_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by dateLabel asc

select coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') as name, coalesce(sum(si.quantity), 0) as value from pos_sale_item si inner join pos_sale s on s.sale_id = si.sale_id left join pos_product p on p.product_id = si.product_id left join pos_category c on c.category_id = p.product_category_id where group by coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') order by value desc

select si.product_name as name, coalesce(sum(si.quantity), 0) as count from pos_sale_item si inner join pos_sale s on s.sale_id = si.sale_id where and s.sale_time >= #{startTime} and s.sale_time < #{endTime} group by si.product_id, si.product_name order by count desc limit #{limit}

select s.sale_no as orderNo, coalesce(nullif(s.create_by, ''), '客户') as customer, coalesce(s.total, 0) as amount, s.status as status, date_format(coalesce(s.sale_time, s.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from pos_sale s order by coalesce(s.sale_time, s.create_time) desc limit #{limit}
